description: This source file defines a health check class 'HomePageHealthCheck' that implements the 'IHealthCheck' interface. It performs an HTTP GET request to the home page URL to verify if specific content ('.NET Bot Black Sweatshirt') is present, indicating health status.

classes.name: HomePageHealthCheck
classes.description: Implements a health check that verifies the presence of specific content on the application's home page to determine health status.

methods.name: CheckHealthAsync
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous HTTP GET request to the home page URL and checks for specific content to determine health status.
